Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

CONNECTING DIMENSIONS, FITS AND 
DIMENSION COMBINATIONS OF HANDS FOR CLOCK 



1. Scope — Covers the connecting dimensions, fits and dimension combinations of hands for clocks. 

2. Hole in Hands 

2.1 Dimensions given in the table are connecting dimensions to hand spindles and hour sleeves. 

2.2 For hands with bushings, the bushings shall conform to 15:12477-1988 'Bushing for hands for 
clocks'. 

2.3 if the minute of second spindle is threaded, the value of di and b shall be taken as thread 
dimensions.

EXLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards relating to clocks. This standard specifies a 
series of preferred dimensions for the holes of clocks hands with a view to achieve type reduction for 
the benefit of both manufacturers and purchasers. This standard will also make repair work easier. 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following: 

IS : 1076-1967 Preferred numbers 

DIN 8270 Blatt 1-1966 Hands for clocks; Connecting dimensions, fits, dimensix)n combinations, 
Deutsches Institut Fur Normung 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
